none: PAS SUR-8F3073: Roman: Bust of Minerva, probably from a vessel
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A cast copper alloy fitting in the form of a helmeted bust of Minerva. The bust is finely modelled; the head leans forward and looks downwards . The eyes are formed from drilled pits and additional facial features have also been added. The figure wears a large circular pendant around her neck. Curling hair projects below her domed helmet whose crest has bunches of feathers with inscribed details.…
